name: fishtank2
title: FishTank2 (DFI, 1997): a Risc PC demo
doc: A recipe: how to turn a user's own copy of the demo into a native executable. It holds no game data: the inputs are recognised by content (see $SS/tools/weave.py). The input is DFI's demo collection as Acorn User's CD 6 (December 1998) has it: the Spark archive EVOLA/CLASSICS/MODERN/DFI, copied off the CD (its !FishTank2 is what's used), or !FishTank2 itself, as a zip or a directory.

discs.name: dfi
discs.title: DFI's demos (Acorn User CD 6: EVOLA.CLASSICS.MODERN.DFI): !FishTank2 - Fishtank2 (packed), QTMTracker 1.27, ModeFile

requires.superspider: ~/stuff/superspider, or $SUPERSPIDER (dune build): analyse, gen (--no-smc), tools/weave.py, tools/arm2.py
requires.libroger: ~/stuff/libroger, or make ROGER=... (SpriteExtend's JPEG SWIs, VDU variable 172)
